scope: ReplayRun owned-kind class-declared identity + tape-pair grammar. The owned kind has exactly ONE legal spelling (the kind name 'replay'); the class-ref spelling is illegal by the owned-kind doctrine. Enforcement: parse-time (owned kind name, reachable for execution docs) + plan-time role check (stat_test precedent, ADR predicate).
non_goals: pair on every P4 replay admission

registration.literal_home: REPLAY_RUN_KIND = "replay" in dskit/pipeline/document.py (per ADR-0127), single owner.
registration.class_home: ReplayRun(Node) lives in dskit/pipeline/trust.py (the capture module); no new file. trust.py already imports node.py (Node) and document.py is NOT imported by trust.py, so no document->trust cycle.
registration.register: trust.py gains a register() function (like the kinds modules); dskit/pipeline/__init__.py imports and calls it: register_node_kind(REPLAY_RUN_KIND, ReplayRun, owned=True).
registration.no_cycle: document.py holds only the literal and does NOT import trust; trust imports node; node imports document; no reverse edge.

identity.class: ReplayRun(Node) with role = "replay" and a declared non-empty outputs tuple; run() RAISES an honest refusal (replay execution requires the F3 composed-tape broker, follow-on) — hpo-grid/clock precedent; does NOT mint any opaque capability.
identity.predicate: resolved.cls.role == "replay" (the ADR-0127 predicate), NOT issubclass — so a custom class declaring role="replay" is also caught. The owned doctrine makes class-ref an illegal spelling.

enforcement.parse: document.py _execution_backtest_node_errors (has execution_backtest context): a node whose NodeSpec.uses == REPLAY_RUN_KIND must declare inputs exactly {tape_manifest, tape_data}, each a complete P5 descriptor. A non-execution document referencing REPLAY_RUN_KIND refuses.
enforcement.plan: planner.py, stat_test precedent: resolved.cls.role == "replay" requires owned=True (refuses class-ref/custom spellings) and enforces the pair for any document that reaches plan.
enforcement.resolves: C1 (no new file, no cycle), C2 (ADR role predicate), M1/M3 (owned kind has one legal spelling; parse is reachable for execution docs; plan role check is the stat_test precedent), M4 (KIND_EFFECTS extended).

positive_grammar: inputs == {tape_manifest: {$captured_artifact: D1}, tape_data: {$captured_artifact: D2}}; D1, D2 each an exact P5 six-field descriptor.

cases: a third input key beside the pair
a renamed port carrying a descriptor
a descriptor as a list/map input value
a non-ReplayRun node declaring the two ports not swept
a class-ref or custom class with role='replay' refused as non-owned (stat_test pattern)

compatibility.p4_replay: pair rule fires only on the ReplayRun owned kind; accepted P4 final-replay fixtures remain green.
compatibility.p5_p6: descriptor shape and generic equality unchanged.
compatibility.purity: pipeline never imports production; ReplayRun is pipeline-owned; trust.py is stdlib-only.

forbidden_effects: planning/stage compilation completes before grammar refusal
node/adapter import or construction before refusal
uses-string resemblance or document role key as identity authority

tests.new: tests/pipeline/test_replay_tape_descriptors.py: positive pair; missing/extra/aliased/nested/wrong_name/identity; class-ref/custom role='replay' owned refusal; ReplayRun.run() refusal; non-execution replay-kind refusal; P4 compatibility; one-name pin (ReplayRun.role == 'replay' == REPLAY_RUN_KIND == owned kind).
tests.census: extend tests/pipeline/test_serving_effect.py KIND_EFFECTS for the new 'replay' kind.
